title: Use own dictionary keys for notebook content and quote selection

scope_proof.method: Full raw-file reconstruction replaces only the stop-word membership predicate and the quote-map initializer; all89 source hashes rechecked after tests.

changes.before: Inherited Object.prototype.constructor was treated as an entry in the fixed stopWords table.
changes.after: Use the existing Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call idiom, so only declared stop-word entries filter content.
changes.preserved: The complete stop-word list, lowercasing, punctuation cleanup, minimum token length, numeric token behavior and token order are unchanged.

changes.before: The first __proto__ quote looked already seen and assigning seen[__proto__]=true could not create an ordinary own membership entry.
changes.after: Use the existing null-prototype dictionary idiom for arbitrary quote keys; first candidates are eligible and repeated keys are stored/deduplicated.
changes.preserved: Sanitization, original-writing grounding, category membership/precedence, example cap, duplicate-category/quote options, fallback order and final guide schema are unchanged.

caller_order_evidence.role: Fixed content-word table and own-membership predicate.
Shared text-connection validator consumes the word list without changing its overlap threshold.
Corrected-quote overlap scorer reuses the same corrected content-word reader.
Shared local addExample records quote keys across required-category and later candidate passes.
ensureNotebookGuide remains the production assembly caller; saved-guide reconstruction retains its current path.

before_failures.name: first prototype quote retained and duplicate rejected

observed.whyThisWorks: This version fixes the grammar in the sentence while keeping your idea.

before_failures.name: prototype quote retained after required category without duplicate

regressions.accepted_contract_control: The __proto__ candidate already passed the existing sanitizer before any app edit. No input/validation contract was widened to manufacture the selection failure.
regressions.ordinary_control: Declared stop words, ordinary words, lowercasing, short tokens and three-digit numeric token behavior pass before and after.
regressions.selection_controls: First supplied __proto__ candidate is retained in the required-category pass and after an ordinary required example; repeated __proto__ quotes stay excluded and order stays intact.
regressions.baseline: All88 preexisting guidance assertions and both related suites passed on the old app. Seven new assertions add five expected failures and two passing controls.

application_metrics.method: Installed read-only RepoWise complexity walker; no index writes.

remaining_expectations: The text dictionary behavior lead is repaired. Existing notebook complexity/shape observations are not claimed cleared; all measured function metrics are unchanged.
Coordinator must accept/commit, refresh RepoWise and run the later publication batch gate. Source remains uncommitted.
limits: No broad75-suite run, fresh coverage capture, live Google/Drive/model calls, real accounts or student data.
This demonstrates incorrect text membership/selection, not prototype pollution or a browser exploit.
No Git mutation, tracker/docs/index writes, other chats/subagents or external messages.
